responsibility: Implements case-conversion helpers for fixed character arrays and single characters, providing uppercasing and lowercasing of strings plus Cap and Lower primitives for individual ASCII letters. It is the dedicated text case transformation module, separate from the broader string-copy/comparison utilities in StrLib and the managed-string operations in DynamicStrings.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file contains the actual ASCII case-conversion logic, including the loops that transform caller buffers and the character-mapping code for Cap and Lower. GStrCase.h only advertises those routines and does not contain the conversion implementation.
